title: 34 ## Cases Disposed of by the Courts : 34,36,274 offences under Local and Special Laws were under trial including cases from the previous years, out of which 0.6% of the cases had to be withdrawn or compounded. The highest percentage for such cases was in respect of Prohibition Act (1.7%) and the lowest for Arms Act and Opium Act, (0.1% for each).
